text: cool now here is one thing u can hunt down for me. it keeps showing me that stop sign has 102 placements. yet i literally have 0 stop signs on my map lol. so uh ??? can we figure that one out haha. il show u, no stop signs at all! [Image #1]
resolution: Investigated the Stop Sign x102 count end to end. The count was real in both the selected session and the hmsc boot game-state, but the packaged game geometry was false: createHmscMapfile called buildWorldInstances without includeGroundLayers, so authored world props including generated stop signs were omitted from the INSTANCES lump. Fixed packageMap to include world layers for real packages and added a package-level regression test that decodes the mapfile instance lump and proves a stopSign red octagon face is emitted.
